name: Airtable Forms
description: Airtable Forms provides standalone and interface-based forms backed by Airtable tables, with sharing, prefills, conditional fields, submission workflows, and automations.
agentUseSummary: Connect a resource-restricted Airtable OAuth grant, then let selected agents list minimized form-view metadata for one explicit base. Relay does not expose personal owner IDs, visible fields, share links, submissions, records, interfaces, automations, or mutations.

capabilities.label: Read form metadata
capabilities.description: Use the pinned List views GET and return only minimized form views for one granted base.

allowed.label: List Airtable forms
allowed.description: List minimized form-view metadata for one explicitly granted base.

blocked.label: Change Airtable forms
blocked.description: Form creation, configuration, publication, sharing, prefills, submissions, records, interfaces, automations, and every mutation remain blocked.

blocked.label: Read form data
blocked.description: Personal view owners, visible fields, share links, prefills, submitted records, attachment URLs, collaborators, interface configuration, and automation runs are blocked.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary Airtable APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary bases, paths, include parameters, scopes, methods, request bodies, record APIs, and automatic pagination are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One minimized form-view index runs directly. User IDs, visible fields, share links, submissions, records, arbitrary APIs, and every mutation remain blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: No Relay-owned Airtable Forms OAuth integration, Railway client credentials, customer authorization, granted base, representative form view, or safe fixture is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register the Airtable Forms OAuth integration with only `workspacesAndBases:read`, configure the exact Relay callback and Railway client credentials, then verify PKCE, resource selection, the minimized form index, assignment, refresh rotation, disconnect, manual provider revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Airtable documents an all-plan GET endpoint returning base view IDs, names, types, optional personal owner IDs, and optional visible grid fields using PAT or OAuth with `workspacesAndBases:read`.
Airtable documents `workspacesAndBases:read` for metadata about workspaces, bases, views, interfaces, blocks, and collaborators; Relay pins the single List views route.

Airtable documents standalone forms, sharing, embedding, prefills, access controls, conditional fields, submission records, a 50-form-per-base limit, and configuration performed in the product UI rather than Relay's API contract.
Airtable documents user-selected base and workspace resource grants, revocation, and third-party OAuth access constrained by user permissions.
